dependencies.statement: The exact bounded semantic merge used by the production codec is machine-checked for associativity, continuity, uniqueness, conservation, and topology independence.
Every experimental backend authenticates exactly the same canonical ZRPF statement and rejects a cross-backend differential corpus identically.
The distributed prover fault, authentication, retry, equivocation, and recovery model is explicit and exercised by fault injection.
The selected folding construction has an explicit large-depth security definition and commitment, transparency, and post-quantum assumptions compatible with ZRPF policy.
A digest-pinned refinement argument connects formal receipt-verifier semantics to the exact external zkVM implementation and its trusted boundary.
Backend comparisons use a retained, exact-identity ZRPF trace/workload corpus with raw samples, failures, timeouts, and resource measurements.
Remote prover capability, operator identity, backend path, freshness, and measured work are authenticated rather than self-reported.
Every required assurance workflow succeeds at the exact integration head.
All V6/V7 image IDs, binaries, receipts, and replay evidence are regenerated from the final governed source.
Every required proof-DAG stage is executable with content-addressed keys, idempotent retries, exact inputs, and bounded resources.
Every conjectural FRI-family soundness dependency is named by exact formulation, version, source digest, and applicability range.
A finite level-specific aggregate-image ladder is built, manifest-bound, negatively tested, and freshly replayed.
A deterministic oracle distinguishes semantics-preserving from semantics-changing ZRPF mutations and records mutation-kill evidence.
A bounded multi-action settlement statement enforces ordered state continuity, global uniqueness, conservation, conflicts, and exact resource ceilings.
A governed, rollback-protected release is executed by a concrete privileged Linux supervisor with fresh hostile-process evidence.
Proof-shape and assumption manifests are enforced by every V6/V7 guest, host planner, worker key, benchmark, and release inventory.
Sampled-DA provider policy, challenge beacon, response timing, independence, and longitudinal window are governed and authenticated.
Receipt tiering or deletion preserves every authenticated root, audit index, recovery object, and DA obligation required by policy.
The pinned RISC Zero line supports repeated Succinct receipt joins and assumption resolution.
The exact bounded semantic types, canonical codec, hash domains, and merge behavior are frozen for formalization.
Every proof-verification event is classified by exact proof mode, parameters, source digest, and a conservative composed failure budget.
The current V6/V7 source-opened statement is explicitly bounded to one ordinary Spot action.

candidates.content: Generate a finite level-specific aggregate-image ladder whose level k image pins level k-1, and bind the complete ladder into a signed manifest.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Repeated join remains available on the pinned backend.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: The ladder recursively verifies the previous level.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Every ladder image and child identity is derived from final source.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: A stale image ladder authenticates stale programs.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The expanded tree commits an admissible multi-action statement.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Tree capacity without settlement capacity is not end-to-end scale.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The extra verification events are included in the soundness budget.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Depth changes the number and class of verification events.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The integration base is green at the exact head.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: New evidence cannot be admitted on a failing base.

candidates.content: Make an executable, source-digested soundness ledger an admission prerequisite, with separate proven and conjectured modes and an exact union-bound event budget.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Every conjecture is named and versioned precisely enough to detect literature drift.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Generic family labels cannot distinguish disproved from modified formulations.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The ledger covers every current verification mode and event class.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Missing events make a union-bound result unsound.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The integration base is green at the exact head.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Admission tooling must start from a passing exact base.

candidates.content: Use a deterministic proof-DAG scheduler with content-addressed node keys, idempotent retries, worker capability attestations, and a receipt cache.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Every stage has a complete deterministic task definition.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: An incomplete graph cannot guarantee reproducible completion.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Worker capability and freshness are authenticated.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Self-reported workers can poison caches and evidence.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Task keys bind final-source identities.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Caching stale proof identities is unsafe.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The integration base is green.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Scheduler evidence must be captured on a passing base.

candidates.content: Resolve groups incrementally and tier or discard intermediate receipts after parent proof, while retaining the authenticated root and audit/DA indexes required by policy.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The parent proof safely replaces retained child receipts.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Retention relies on exact parent-child authentication.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Policy identifies every object needed for audit and recovery.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Deleting unclassified objects can make recovery impossible.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: External retrievability evidence remains governed after tiering.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: A root is not data availability.

candidates.content: Probe and attest the actual prover backend, accelerator path, binary/source digest, and measured throughput instead of inferring acceleration from the host OS or documentation.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Capability evidence is bound to trusted worker identity and measured work.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Self-reporting is not attestation.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The measured workload is the final source workload.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Performance evidence does not transfer across image drift.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The measured exact head passes assurance.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: A benchmark cannot override a failing assurance gate.

candidates.content: Add a ZRPF-specific metamorphic and fault-injection corpus spanning guest semantics, receipts, journals, image IDs, levels, ordering, profiles, and assumptions.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The oracle correctly labels preserving and changing mutations.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: A wrong oracle can turn false positives into assurance claims.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The integration base is green before corpus results are interpreted.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Unrelated failures must not be hidden by mutation results.

candidates.content: Calibrate segment size, fanout, accelerator, and memory profiles while requiring every profile to authenticate the same semantic statement and carry its own soundness budget.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The selected backend path is authenticated and measured.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Profile choice must bind actual capability.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Each profile has a complete composed soundness budget.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Resource tuning can alter security parameters.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Every profile points to exact applicable conjectures.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Profiles cannot share an ambiguous assumption label.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Cross-profile comparison uses the same final statement and source.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Different program identities invalidate performance comparison.

candidates.content: Prototype an append-only base-8 carry forest that holds O(log n) live receipts and finalizes through the finite level-specific image ladder.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Every carry level authenticates the preceding level.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: The carry forest inherits ladder soundness.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: O(log n) live receipts preserve required audit and recovery data.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Small live state must not destroy recoverability.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Partial and final forest states map to unambiguous settlement semantics.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Partial finalization otherwise has no authority-safe meaning.

candidates.content: Define a bounded multi-action Spot settlement statement before increasing aggregate fanout.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The current one-action statement is the compatibility baseline.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Batch semantics must conservatively extend the current statement.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The proposed bounded batch invariants are complete.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: This is the new authority statement.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The merge preserves the batch invariants.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Composition correctness is the core batch property.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Fresh proof evidence binds the final batch guest.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Proof authority cannot survive source drift.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The base is green.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: The new semantic path must begin from a passing base.

candidates.content: Enforce the proof-shape and assumption registries in every V6/V7 guest, planner, worker, benchmark, and release inventory.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Every acceptance path consumes the same shape manifest.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: A protocol-only registry does not constrain production execution.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Shape choices map to exact soundness entries.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Resource profiles can change verification event budgets.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Manifests bind final program identities.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Shape evidence must follow source changes.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The base is green.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Runtime enforcement must be tested on a passing base.

candidates.content: Formalize the exact bounded semantic merge in Lean and connect the theorem inputs to canonical production fixtures.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The model target and canonical codec are frozen.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: A theorem about a drifting abstraction does not cover production bytes.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: All target invariants and bounds are represented in the theorem.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Omitted bounds or uniqueness conditions invalidate the assurance claim.

candidates.content: Model-check V5 atomic settlement, finality cursor, release-head, revocation, rollback, crash, and replay interleavings before authority activation.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The modeled release/runtime contract matches the concrete authority port.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: A model of a non-existent port cannot authorize the future implementation.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: DA observations used by the store are governed and authenticated.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Atomic persistence does not make unauthenticated availability true.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The implementation being modeled passes exact-head assurance.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Model evidence cannot hide implementation test failures.

candidates.content: Create an authority-free backend adapter laboratory that differentially benchmarks STIR, WHIR, BaseFold/DeepFold, Jagged PCS, Binius-family, and Circle-STARK candidates against the pinned ZRPF statement ABI and assumption profile.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Every backend authenticates and rejects the exact same canonical statement corpus.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Performance is irrelevant if statement semantics differ.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Each candidate's exact proximity assumptions and affected parameter regimes are versioned.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Backend comparison must not erase assumption drift.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Each candidate has a composed event-level soundness budget.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Proof size or speed alone cannot rank security.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The benchmark ABI and canonical statement are frozen.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: A moving ABI destroys differential comparability.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Comparisons retain raw samples, failures, timeouts, and exact workload identity.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Published external benchmarks do not measure ZRPF.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The comparison base is green at the exact head.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Experimental results cannot override a failing base.

candidates.content: Evaluate distributed transparent PCS candidates only behind a fault-injected benchmark lane; first distribute the existing deterministic proof DAG before replacing the pinned proof system.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The existing proof DAG supplies a deterministic distribution baseline.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Protocol replacement must beat the lower-risk orchestration baseline.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Distributed workers and measured work are authenticated.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Unauthenticated workers invalidate accountability claims.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The benchmark covers crash, equivocation, omission, retry, and recovery behavior.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Happy-path speed does not establish distributed assurance.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Both distribution strategies use the same exact workload corpus.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Different inputs make the comparison meaningless.

candidates.content: Keep Nova-family and post-quantum folding schemes in an authority-free research lane until their commitment assumptions, recursion security definition, and statement semantics match ZRPF policy.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The folding prototype proves the exact ZRPF statement ABI.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: IVC efficiency does not imply semantic equivalence.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Commitment, transparency, post-quantum, and depth-security assumptions match policy.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Common folding instantiations change the trusted assumption profile.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The folding and terminal proof events have a complete composed budget.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Bounded experiments cannot justify unbounded-depth claims.

candidates.content: Extend the existing Lean layer toward a digest-pinned formal bridge for the receipt verifier and soundness-envelope algebra, while treating the external zkVM implementation as an explicit trusted boundary until refinement is proved.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The theorem is connected to exact executable verifier semantics or declares the gap trusted.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: A theorem about an abstract verifier cannot silently authorize an implementation.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: Canonical receipt and statement inputs are digest-pinned.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: Formal inputs must match production bytes.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The formal envelope names every external cryptographic assumption.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: External assumptions remain explicit trusted boundaries.

assumption_dependencies.assumed_statement: The bridge pins final-source verifier and guest identities.
assumption_dependencies.rationale: A formal digest must change with the implementation.

non_claims: A structurally valid graph is not a promotion authorization.
A BLOCKED candidate may be implemented only in an authority-false experimental lane.
A benchmark, fuzz corpus, bounded model, or local theorem does not independently prove cryptographic soundness.
Finite sampled retrievability does not establish continuous or future public data availability.
The decision graph is derived research evidence and does not replace the repository CBC matrix.
